content:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a concentrated copy mini-sprint for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages. Goal: tighten hero, single-sentence benefit, CTA variants, and one short launch post + webinar blurb. Can we do a 48h pass?
ethan: :thumbsup: yes. propose splitting by mode: maya+ana on Hosted hero + launch post, jules on Dedicated, i’ll draft Private + webinar hook.
jules: I’ll take Dedicated. thinking angle: 'predictable throughput, reserved cost certainty' — short line + micro bullet. will post examples in a bit.
nana: @maya putting together benchmark narrative copy for the launch post — want an economy-focused lede (latency vs cost) and an engineering lede (runtime optimizations). do we want both?
maya: yes — two liftlines: econ + eng. we’ll A/B test which drives signups for the demo CTA.
ethan: for hero CTA options: `Get started (free credits)`, `Book a demo`, `Estimate cost` — which maps to inbound routing?
jules: map: `Get started` -> self-serve funnel, `Book a demo` -> sales lead form, `Estimate cost` -> pricing tool (capture email).
maya: inbound routing: use UTM + hidden field to tag mode. e.g., `utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=hero_cta` and hidden `page_mode=hosted|dedicated|private`. sam-bot will auto-tag leads.
sam-bot: copied. I’ll add rules: if CTA==Book a demo AND mode==dedicated -> assign to AE queue; if mode==private -> compliance/named-ops follow-up.
nana: for webinar blurb (1-liner + CTA): "See how teams cut inference costs 3x without sacrificing latency — join our live demo" + `Register`. keep under 140 chars.
jules: hero variants (rough):
- Hosted: "Hosted API — launch fast, scale later. Low-latency text & embeddings out of the box."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — predictable throughput, isolated data, SLA-backed performance."
- Private: "Private deployment — VPC & on-prem control for regulated workloads."
will iterate micro-bullets after feedback.
ethan: love the tone. tweak Hosted to include "free credits" mention? e.g., "...out of the box — free credits to get started."
maya: small ask: keep hero lines <= 80 characters where possible for mobile. also need 2nd-line support: 8–10 word subheads.
nana: launch post outline:
1) quick problem statement (cost + reliability)
2) how Redwood solves (runtime + routing + deployments)
3) benchmark highlight (3x cost reduction example) + link to gist
4) CTA cluster: Get started / Book demo / Webinar register
— do we want a short customer quote?
jules: yes, 1-sentence quote from beta customer: "Saved us 60% on inference spend while improving p99 latency."
maya: ok timeline: 24h drafts, 24h review, then ops to wire CTAs/forms. @ana @sam-bot can you confirm lead routing and UTMs by EOD?
nana: I’ll drop the benchmark copy + link to the Gist by 6pm PT.
sam-bot: Lead routing rules posted to #marketing-ops at 5:40pm PT. I’ll include mapping and test vectors.
ethan: tiny UX question — for `Estimate cost` modal, should we require signup? thinking conversion tradeoffs.
maya: prefer soft gate: email optional but encouraged; if they click estimate->email not provided, show inline CTA `Get started` with credit offer.
jules: will update microcopy accordingly.
ethan: any objections to using `Get started with free credits` on Hosted hero button? fewer words: `Start free` ?
maya: `Start free` wins for mobile. good.
nana: webinar registration copy (short): "Live: How teams make inference predictable & cheap — demo + AMAs" + `Register`
jules: I’ll push the Dedicated hero live copy + variant CTAs to the staging page and share screenshots.
maya: perfect. thanks team — we’ll reconvene after drafts. :rocket:
